description: Real-time solar wind measurements from the active spacecraft at L1: proton speed (km/s), density (n/cm³), temperature (K), and the critical Bz component (southward Bz = negative = storm driver). Returns the recent plasma and magnetic field time series within the requested window, oldest first, each record tagged with the reporting spacecraft and bounded to 200 records per series unless resolution is set to "full" — or omitted entirely under "summary", which keeps the latest readings, Bz status, and window extremes (peak speed, density, and Bt; most southward Bz; minutes of southward Bz) for "what is Bz doing now" questions. Bz < −10 nT for sustained periods is a primary geomagnetic storm trigger — use alongside noaa_spaceweather_get_kp_index to see whether elevated solar wind has translated into a geomagnetic storm.

resolution.description: Detail level of the returned plasma and mag series. "summary" returns both series empty and keeps every headline field — about 2 KB whatever the window. "reduced" (default) bounds each series to at most 200 records: the window is bucketed by record count and one real measurement is emitted per bucket — the bucket's fastest speed for plasma, its most southward Bz for mag — with the newest record in the window always last. A series already inside the bound is returned untouched, so a default 3-hour call is unaffected. "full" returns every record in the window (~1,400 per series over 24 hours, a ~540 KB response). The headline fields — latestPlasma, latestMag, bzStatus, bzMinInWindow, and the window maxima and southward-Bz minutes — are computed from the full window at every resolution.

window_hours.description: Hours of recent solar wind history to return (1–168, default 3). Records update ~every 1 min, but the feed only carries roughly the last 24 hours — a larger window returns the whole feed, not more history, and at the default resolution the returned series stay bounded to 200 records each rather than growing with the window. When a window comes back empty, feedStalenessHours and latestFeedPlasmaTime/latestFeedMagTime report how current the feed actually is.

name: noaa_spaceweather_get_solar_wind

btMaxInWindow.description: Peak Bt in nT across the whole window; null when it has no Bt.

bzMinInWindow.description: Most southward Bz in nT across the whole window; null when it has no Bz.

bzMinTimeTag.description: ISO 8601 time of bzMinInWindow; null when it is null.

bzSouthMinutesInWindow.description: Minutes of Bz < 0: 1-minute mag records across the whole window. Feed gaps are not counted. 0 when none.

bzStatus.description: Bz status from latestMag, e.g. "Southward Bz -14 nT — storm-driving conditions."; "Bz data unavailable." without a reading.

densityMaxInWindow.description: Peak proton density in particles/cm³ across the whole window; null when none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: SWPC feed returns 5xx or 429, times out, or answers with a body that is not parseable JSON. Retried for up to 45 seconds in total before failing. `feed_moved`: SWPC feed path returns a permanent 4xx (404, 410, 401, 403). Fails in one attempt. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

feedStalenessHours.description: Hours from the newest record in either feed to now; null when both are empty.

latestFeedMagTime.description: ISO 8601 time of the newest mag record in the feed, window aside; null when none.

latestFeedPlasmaTime.description: ISO 8601 time of the newest plasma record in the feed, window aside; null when none.

bt.description: Total field Bt in nT; null when missing.

bxGsm.description: Bx, GSM, in nT; null when missing.

byGsm.description: By, GSM, in nT; null when missing.

bzGsm.description: Bz, GSM, in nT; negative (southward) drives storms; null when missing.

latestMag.description: Newest mag record in the window; null when the window has none.

densityPerCm3.description: Proton density in particles/cm³; null when missing.

speedKmS.description: Solar wind speed in km/s; null when missing.

temperatureK.description: Proton temperature in K; null when missing.

latestPlasma.description: Newest plasma record in the window; null when the window has none.

mag.description: Mag records in the window, oldest first. "reduced": at most 200, each its bucket's most southward Bz; the last equals latestMag. Empty under "summary".

bt.description: Total field Bt in nT; null when missing.

bxGsm.description: Bx, GSM, in nT; null when missing.

byGsm.description: By, GSM, in nT; null when missing.

bzGsm.description: Bz, GSM, in nT; negative (southward) drives storms; null when missing.

magBucketRecords.description: Mag records per emitted record, 1 if untouched. Present only after a reduction.

magCount.description: Records in mag (magWindowRecords has the pre-reduction total); under "summary", the records the window held.

magWindowRecords.description: Mag records in the window before reduction. Present after a reduction or under "summary".

notice.description: What shaped the response: an empty window (with the newest feed record), series bounded to 200 records, or series omitted under "summary".

plasma.description: Plasma records in the window, oldest first. "reduced": at most 200, each its bucket's fastest speed, newest last. Empty under "summary".

densityPerCm3.description: Proton density in particles/cm³; null when missing.

speedKmS.description: Solar wind speed in km/s; null when missing.

temperatureK.description: Proton temperature in K; null when missing.

plasmaBucketRecords.description: Plasma records per emitted record, 1 if untouched. Present only after a reduction.

plasmaCount.description: Records in plasma (plasmaWindowRecords has the pre-reduction total); under "summary", the records the window held.

plasmaWindowRecords.description: Plasma records in the window before reduction. Present after a reduction or under "summary".

speedMaxInWindow.description: Peak speed in km/s across the whole window; null when it has no speed.

speedMaxTimeTag.description: ISO 8601 time of speedMaxInWindow; null when it is null.
